scripts.back: docker compose up -d && cd backend && uv run python -u manage.py runserver
scripts.back:install: cd backend && uv venv --allow-existing && uv run pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.back:migrate: cd backend && uv run python -u manage.py migrate
scripts.install:all: pnpm install && pnpm front:install && pnpm back:install
scripts.init:all: pnpm install:all && pnpm back:migrate && pnpm dev
